home.heroTitle: A night or a month, a room of your own.
home.heroLead: No deposit to worry about, only as long as you need. Stay from one night to a whole season — the longer you stay, the less each night costs.
home.tiersTitle: The longer you stay, the less each night costs
home.tiersLead: Book from one night. Discounts start at 7, 28 and 90 nights and apply on their own, no coupon needed. No need to hunt for special month-long listings either.

hoods.seongsu: Old factories and workshops turned into cafés, with Seoul Forest at the end of the street.

home.livingTitle: Not just somewhere to sleep — everything you need to live

furnished.title: Just bring yourself
furnished.text: Bed, bedding, a desk, heating and air conditioning are all there. Bring a suitcase, not a removal van.

price.title: No hidden costs
price.text: The nightly price you see is the price you pay. There's no guest fee, and totals include cleaning.

managed.title: Run by MONTHLIV

station.title: Close to the station

host.label: MONTHLIV partners
host.title: You bring the space, we run it
host.lead: MONTHLIV handles it all: the build, looking after guests, cleaning, upkeep and going round in person when something goes wrong. You follow how your branch is doing through notifications and the partner centre.
host.whyTitle: Why partners leave the running to MONTHLIV

cleaning.title: Running it, start to finish
cleaning.text: Guest care, cleaning, upkeep and call-outs are all on MONTHLIV. The MONTHLIV name only goes on branches we run in full like this.

income.title: The build, in photos every day
income.text: Once work starts, each branch gets a group chat where we post the day's progress and site photos. No need to stand guard on site.

guests.title: Every step, in a notification
guests.text: Once the branch opens, room-tour bookings, payments and extensions reach you automatically as KakaoTalk notifications.

host.rateTitle: One nightly price sets the price for every length of stay
host.rateText: Guests can book from one night. The week, month and season discounts set the price for every length of stay, so there are no separate month-long rooms to manage. You can see your branch's prices and discounts in the partner centre.

list.title: Talk and site visit
list.text: We see the space for ourselves and work through the room plan and the numbers with you.

price.title: The build
price.text: We build it ourselves and post progress and site photos to the group chat every day.

welcome.title: Opening and running
welcome.text: The branch opens under the MONTHLIV name. We handle guests, cleaning and upkeep.

paid.title: Getting paid
paid.text: You're paid the price of the nights less the operating fee. Stays of 28 nights or more are paid out monthly after that.

oneRoom.q: Can a place another firm built become a MONTHLIV?
oneRoom.a: Yes, if MONTHLIV inspected it and agreed the plans while it was being built. As a rule, places that are already running and where we only take over the management don't carry our name.

leaveEarly.q: What if a guest wants to leave early?
leaveEarly.a: Guests staying 28 nights or more can leave early with notice. The nights they stayed are priced for that length of stay. [policy to be confirmed]

english.q: Do you take guests from abroad?
english.a: Yes. Messages are translated both ways and MONTHLIV looks after the guests, so you don't need another language.

allowed.q: Can I run it myself and just use the MONTHLIV name?
allowed.a: A partner model like that, where you run the branch under our name, is still being prepared. For now the MONTHLIV name goes only on branches we run in full.

fees.a: {direct, number}% of the price of the nights at branches MONTHLIV built, and from {other, number}% elsewhere, agreed case by case. Guests see the branch's price as it is, with no fee on top. At {price} a night, you're paid {payout} a night (at a branch we built).

help.discountA: Every place can be booked from one night. The longer you stay, the lower the nightly price, and the discount applies to your whole stay, not just the extra nights. Each branch sets its own discounts.
help.discountExample: Example: a studio at {price} a night
help.discountMove: If you extend into a longer band, the new price applies to the whole stay. We show you the difference before you pay.

oneNight.q: Can I book just one night?
oneNight.a: Yes. Unless the host has set a longer minimum, every place can be booked from one night. You'll see the minimum stay on the listing.

extend.q: How do I extend my stay?
extend.a: Select “Extend your stay” in your booking. Before we ask the host, we show you the new total with your discount.

leaveEarly.q: What if I need to leave early?
leaveEarly.a: It depends on the cancellation terms you booked with. For 28 nights or more, you can leave early with notice, and the nights you stayed are priced for that length of stay. [policy to be confirmed]

monthly.a: For 28 nights or more, you pay part now and the rest on set days. Each part is charged to the payment method you chose.

translate.a: The site shows in your language. Listings, reviews and messages written in another language are translated and marked “Translated”. The original is one tap away.

refunds.a: Each place has the cancellation policy shown when you booked. Cancel before the free-cancellation deadline for a full refund; after that, you get back what the policy allows. Refunds go back to the way you paid. [refund policy to be confirmed]

safety.q: How do I know guests and hosts can be trusted?
safety.a: Every guest and host verifies their ID. The exact address is shared only after a booking is confirmed, and payment always happens on MONTHLIV. If something goes wrong, use “Report this conversation” in your messages.

hosting.q: I'd like to open a MONTHLIV branch
hosting.a: See how it works and what the operating fee is on the partner page. MONTHLIV takes care of the build, the front desk, cleaning and upkeep.

trash.title: Rubbish and recycling
trash.text: Seoul sorts rubbish three ways. General waste goes in the district's official bags (there's a roll in the drawer under the sink), food waste in the yellow bin by the entrance, and recycling separated into paper, plastic, cans and glass. Put it out after 6 pm on the days listed on the noticeboard by the entrance.

laundry.title: Laundry
laundry.text: The washing machine is next to the sink, and the manual is in the drawer underneath. The standard cycle takes about 50 minutes. For a dryer, use the launderette on the ground floor.

heating.title: Underfloor heating and hot water
heating.text: The boiler control is on the wall by the front door. When you're away for a while, set it to 'Away' so the pipes don't freeze. Hot water comes through after about 30 seconds.

building.title: Getting in and the building
building.text: The building and your front door open with the same code. Parcels go to the lockers on the ground floor. You're on the third floor, with no lift.

quiet.title: Quiet hours 10 pm–7 am
quiet.text: Please keep it down from 10 pm to 7 am for the neighbours. The washing machine and vacuum rest then too.

about.label: About MONTHLIV
about.lead: MONTHLIV is a home you stay in by the month. Stay a night or live a month: we open rooms of your own, comfortable and good to live in, one neighbourhood at a time. Every branch is run by GosuPlus Co., Ltd.
about.termsText: The full terms of service will be published here before the service opens. This is a preview, so no bookings or payments actually take place. [terms to be confirmed]
about.privacyLead: Before the full privacy policy is published, here are the principles MONTHLIV follows with personal information.

privacy.ids: We don't store resident registration or passport numbers. For ID checks we only receive the result from the verification provider.
privacy.cards: We don't store card numbers. Payments use tokens issued by the payment gateway.
privacy.address: A place's exact address is shared only with the guest, after the booking is confirmed. Until then we show an approximate location.
privacy.security: Member information is locked down in the database itself, so only you and the staff who need it can see it.
privacy.rights: You can see your information on My page at any time, and ask us to correct or delete it.

about.privacyFull: The full policy, covering what we collect, why, how long we keep it, who processes it for us and our privacy officer, will be published before the service opens. [privacy policy to be confirmed]

payouts.lead: Paid out the day after check-in, then every 28 nights for stays of 28 nights or more.
payouts.scheduledNote: {count, plural, one {# payout} other {# payouts}} to come
payouts.accountNote: The full account number stays with the payout provider; MONTHLIV shows only the last four digits.
payouts.taxNote: Partners file their own taxes on income from stays. Use the downloaded history when you do.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.lead: Send a coupon by member ID to guests who have booked your places, so they come back. The discount comes out of your payout.
coupons.rules: Branch coupons work only at your branches. A booking can use one coupon.

payouts.lead: Partner payouts by date, and the ones on hold. A payout is the price for the nights less the branch's operating fee ({direct, number}% at branches we built, from {other, number}% elsewhere), plus cleaning.

support.title: Support
support.lead: Urgent first. Replies reach the member translated into their language.
support.replyPlaceholder: Write your reply to the member.
support.translateNote: Write in Korean and it reaches them in their language.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Values that apply across the service. Every change and who made it is logged.
settings.serviceFeeNote: MONTHLIV charges guests no fee. At 0%, guests see the branch's price as it is.
settings.hostFeeNote: The default for branches MONTHLIV built. Taken from the price for the nights at payout; cleaning has none.
settings.stayNote: Default discounts fill in for new rooms; each branch can change them.
settings.sectionsLead: The kinds of place shown along the top of the site.
settings.rolesLead: Choose what each role can open. The owner role can't be changed.
settings.securityNote: Staff accounts must use two-step sign-in, and every look at member details is kept for a year.
settings.otherFeeNote: Where to start for branches another firm built; agreed branch by branch.
